basic_details.job_title: Sainik School Goalpara Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 13 LDC, PGT, TGT and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Sainik School Goalpara is recruiting for 13 vacancies across posts including Quarter Master, PGT (Physics), TGT (Mathematics), TGT (Social Science), Band Master, PTI Cum Matron (Female), and others under advertisement number SSG/ 03 /2026. The notified pay includes Rs. 29,200 for the Quarter Master, Rs. 57,120 per month for PGT (Physics), and Rs. 53,880 per month for TGT posts. Eligible applicants must submit the offline application by post or hand on or before 12 November 2026. application_fee.details: The application fee is non-refundable and must be paid via a Demand Draft (DD) drawn in favour of “Principal, Sainik School, Goalpara” payable at State Bank of India, Mornai (Code No. 9148).

age_limit.details: Candidates must not be below 18 years and above 50 years of age as on 12 Nov 2026 for Quarter Master, Band Master, PTI Cum Matron (Female), Mess Manager, LDC, Ward Boy, Office Superintendent, System Administrator, and Horse Riding Instructor. For PGT and TGT posts, candidates must not be below 21 years and above 50 years of age as on 12 Nov 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is Sainik School Goalpara Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Sainik School Goalpara recruitment 2026 is an employment notification inviting offline applications for 13 regular and contractual vacancies across various administrative and teaching positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 13 vacancies are available across various posts including Quarter Master, PGT, TGT, Band Master, PTI Cum Matron, Mess Manager, LDC, Ward Boy, Office Superintendent, System Administrator, and Horse Riding Instructor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications at Sainik School Goalpara by post or hand is 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for General and SC/ST/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The non-refundable application fee is Rs. 300/- for General category candidates and Rs. 200/- for SC/ST/OBC categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection procedure?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Test, followed by a Skill Test or Class Demonstration and an Interview for candidates who qualify the written test.
